## Smartlead Reply Tracking v5 (2026-09-23, fixed same day)
Scope: only EMAIL_SENT, EMAIL_REPLIED, EMAIL_BOUNCED, and LEAD_CATEGORY_UPDATED get logged to Sent Log. EMAIL_OPENED/CLICKED/UNSUBSCRIBED are dropped. Append-only, all campaigns account-wide (webhook id 875223).

Report tab has exactly 3 sections, laid out left to right:
- DAILY (A:F): date, Sent, Replied, Reply Rate %, Bounced, Bounce Rate %. Pure per-day activity - fine to sum every event.
- MONTHLY (H:Q): month, Sent, Replied, Reply Rate %, Bounced, Bounce Rate %, OOO, Interested, Not Interested, Sender Originated Bounce. Same activity columns as Daily, PLUS category columns merged directly into the same table (not a separate section). The category columns (N:Q) read from Section 3's detail list, not from raw Sent Log events, so a lead recategorized this month after being wrong last month shows up once, in this month's new bucket only.
- CURRENT CATEGORY STATE (S:V): live snapshot, deduped by lead. S5 spills unique lead_emails with a category event; T5 finds each one's LAST matching ROW NUMBER in Sent Log (not timestamp - Sheets does not auto-parse a full ISO8601 string with T/Z/milliseconds as a date, so a MAXIFS-on-timestamp approach silently returns 0; row number works because Sent Log is strictly append-only, so the physically last matching row IS the latest event); U5 pulls the category at that row via MAP+INDEX; V5 pulls that row's month the same way - this V column is what Monthly's category formulas read from. S2:V3 are live COUNTIF totals over the deduped U column.

Date/month columns (A, H, and the category_month helper at V) are formatted as real dates (yyyy-mm-dd / yyyy-mm) via a direct Sheets API numberFormat call - without this they display as raw serial numbers (46288 instead of 2026-08-15).

Known fragility, twice observed: incremental single/few-cell writes near these spilling array formulas (MAP/FILTER/SORT/UNIQUE) have twice caused entire pre-existing formula blocks to silently vanish - not just recompute wrong, the stored formula text itself gone on the next read. Root cause not identified. Every fix in this section has been done as one full clear-and-rewrite of the whole area in a single batchUpdate call, never a patch to one or two cells - that has been reliable both times. If this area ever looks wrong again, rebuild the whole Report tab area, don't try to patch a single cell.

Also logged for the record: a row-cleanup step once deleted ALL Sent Log data (not just the intended bad rows) because the result wasn't re-verified after running. Caught immediately, no lasting damage - every delete since has been verified right after with a real read.

Field extraction fixed against a REAL LEAD_CATEGORY_UPDATED payload (webhook event_id 81c48d4a-1670-4ef0-a89a-8a553f60ab7a) - lead info is under body.lead_data not body.lead; category arrives as both a string (body.category) and an object (body.lead_data.category). Category matching criteria fixed against the account's real category list (GET /api/v1/leads/fetch-categories): real names are "Out Of Office" and "Not Interested" - those exact strings are what the formulas match on, "OOO"/"Uninterest" are just this report's shorter column labels. "Sender Originated Bounce" and "Interested" match real category names exactly.

Confirmed live: manually recategorizing a lead in the Smartlead UI DOES re-fire this webhook. Verified live with a real cross-month recategorization test before trusting the no-double-count design.

Webhook path includes a random token instead of verifying Smartlead HMAC signatures - deliberate, documented in Parse Event.
